issuer.summary: A short operating record, unresolved legal accountability and discretionary revenue delivery support retaining the existing cautious issuer assessment. The predecessor Convergence exploit is material operating lineage, not an established USG exploit; it removes any inference of a wholly incident-free team history. USG offers no borrower-collateral redemption. sUSG returns USG and documents a 25% revenue allocation, not a guaranteed payout covenant. Snapshot/legacy Convergence venues need continuity review before a governance mapping or executed-policy claim.
